title: Karnataka High Court rules against oil marketing companies in ethanol procurement case
description: The Karnataka High Court recently directed Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited (BPCL), Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL) and Indian Oil Corporation Limited (IOCL) to honour an agreement to procure ethanol from a dedicated ethanol plant (DEP) [VINP Distilleries and Sugars Pvt Ltd v. Union of India & Ors].Justice M Nagaprasanna observed that the petitioner ethanol plant had a legitimate expectation after entering into an exclusive supplying contract with the oil marketing compani
